description: Fork of exp100 with n_alternatives changed from 3 to 1 (smooth_mode=True kept). Goal: isolate whether the +0.058 gap between exp104 (Tiny, na=1, no smooth) and exp100 (MHLut, na=3, smooth) is from n_alternatives or from smooth_mode/MHLut runtime. exp113 (clone of exp108 with MHLut na=1 smooth=True, also single big-table-per-output regime) is currently mid-trajectory ~0.01 ahead of exp108; this run does the same swap on exp100's full architecture. All other settings match exp100: E=384, d_qk=32, d_v=64, MHLut+ext.SparseScatter (i.i.d. SparseScatter, NOT balanced, to match exp100 exactly), nap=8, qk/v tph=384 n_sparse=8, out tph=2048 n_sparse=8.
